decision: 依使用者授權，保留目前可驗收的流程新增/刪除/排序/名稱/路徑儲存段落；復原與重做排入未來處理，不宣稱等價完成。

evidence.active_operations: src/components/landing-pages/funnel-operations-panel.tsx persistContent saves immediately with revision CAS; no flow history
evidence.unused_history_ui: src/components/landing-pages/funnel-step-pages-editor.tsx has undo/redo history but is not mounted by active workspace

acceptance_for_future: Active operations UI exposes flow undo/redo for add/delete/reorder/rename/path changes
Undo/redo persistence uses current server revision and does not overwrite concurrent changes
Failed save preserves local state and history consistently
Browser verifies undo/redo, reload persistence and conflict handling
